Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (RAP-MS) is an affinity purification/interactome study to identify binding partners of the DUBR ncRNA. While the broader paper describes differential experiments (GapmeR knockdown), the MS dataset (PXD057811) specifically compares the DUBR-capture proteome against control captures (Luciferase and U1). This is not a perturbation/differential expression study of the proteome, but a discovery-based interactome analysis, thus mapped to 'un-classified'.
